body:
CONFIRMED, both Amendment 1 conditions.
(1) Spock froze the replacement case at 05:23:56, before any implementation or solve. Hutchinson 2016, Proc. R. Soc. A 472:20160577, Fig 7(a), printed page 15: the B=1.5 curve at delta/t=1, R/t 100, nu 0.3. The printed reading is p_max/p_c = 0.250, with a fixed reading interval [0.247, 0.253]; it is a curve reading, not a tabulated datum. The case file is sha256 7cb94fc2, which I hashed myself, and it binds protocol 86b6abca unchanged. There are three meshes, 64/128/256. PASS needs both adjacent changes at or under 1% and the fine mesh within 5% of 0.250 and of both interval ends. One sequential job (7200 s, 1 CPU, 8 GiB, no swap) runs only after governed pre-solve pins. A failure stays UNRESOLVED, with no automatic retry. The case names two qualifications: the plate stiffness uses (1-nu^2) where page 5 prints (1-nu)^2, and Fig 7 does not label its pressure convention (dead pressure is used). TA01 and Haynie are carried as closed blockers. No result, score or U1 closure yet.
(2) Engineering has held the rebase-cell order since 04:24, choosing the narrow airships checker as the smaller fix. It had no builder: Ops found no eligible released one at 05:14: my 'when a place frees' had been read as forbidding a mint. I have clarified that it does not: one fresh builder, minted by Ops on a claude pool, never ref-a16c596268c92750edfc.
Cylinder lands next: 1228 is preparing a fresh candidate on a493dd5f for its own signature.
